trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for TELECOM.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- network_complaint: Diagnose coverage and speed complaints against live network status and raise a field ticket where warranted.
- recharge_and_plan: Recharge a prepaid number, migrate a plan and explain validity and benefits from the live catalogue.

Business context:
- network_complaint: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.
- recharge_and_plan: Indian telecom contact centre. Prepaid recharges, plan migrations, data exhaustion and coverage complaints. Plan changes have cycle rules and network faults have defined resolution windows.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [network_complaint]
  - Known outage first: Where a known outage covers the area, the tool's ETA is quoted and no duplicate ticket is raised.
  - Diagnose before ticket: A line diagnostic must run before a ticket is raised, so the category is evidenced.
  - No coverage promises: The agent must not promise coverage improvement beyond the ticket's stated window.
  - Handset limits: Where the diagnostic reports the handset unsupported, that is stated rather than blamed on the network.
  [recharge_and_plan]
  - Catalogue truth: Only plans returned by list_plans may be offered, with the price and validity the tool returns.
  - Postpaid cycle: A postpaid plan change takes effect from the next billing cycle, never immediately.
  - No benefit invention: Bundled benefits may only be described where the plan record carries them.
  - Balance before recharge: Existing balance and validity must be read before a recharge is recommended.

Tools available to you (7): apply_recharge, check_network_status, list_plans, lookup_subscriber, raise_network_ticket, run_line_diagnostic, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: te-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: apply_recharge
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a recharge or plan migration to the subscriber.

model_visible_tools.name: check_network_status
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve tower status, known outages and congestion for a location.

model_visible_tools.name: list_plans
model_visible_tools.description: List plans available to this subscriber with price, validity and data.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_subscriber
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve plan, balance, validity, data left and billing cycle position. Read before any recharge is recommended.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_network_ticket
model_visible_tools.description: Raise a field ticket with a resolution window.

model_visible_tools.name: run_line_diagnostic
model_visible_tools.description: Run a remote diagnostic on the subscriber's connection.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Asks a clarifying question before agreeing to anything consequential.
Restates figures back to the agent to confirm understanding.
Volunteers context the agent did not ask for.
Needs reassurance before committing; hesitates once.

steps.purpose: User reports slow data and provides their MSISDN.
steps.clean_text: Hello, నా internet చాలా slow గా ఉంది. నా number MSN-2002.
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, నా internet చాలా flow గా ఉంది. నా number MSN-2002.

steps.purpose: Agent apologizes and asks for date of birth to verify identity.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent asks only for the missing date of birth to verify identity, without asking for every detail at once.
steps.text: మీకు కలిగిన అసౌకర్యానికి క్షమించండి. Account verify చేయడానికి మీ date of birth చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: The agent needs to verify the caller's identity before checking network specifics, and asks only for DOB.

steps.purpose: User provides their date of birth and asks a clarifying question before proceeding.
steps.clean_text: నా date of birth 15th August 1995. ఇది solve అవ్వడానికి ఎంత time పడుతుంది?
steps.model_visible_text: నా date of birth 15th August 1999. ఇది solve అవ్వడానికి ఎంత time పడుతుంది?

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided date of birth.
Return the failed verification result due to corrupted DOB.
Agent informs of verification failure and requests an alternative factor.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent politely informs the user of the mismatch and asks only for a new verification factor.
steps.text: క్షమించండి, date of birth match అవ్వలేదు. Verification కోసం మీ registered pincode చెప్పగలరా?
steps.planner_rationale: Identity verification failed due to mismatched DOB, so the agent requests the registered pincode.

steps.purpose: User provides pincode and volunteers context about their situation.
steps.clean_text: Oh, sorry. నా pincode 560001. నేను online classes attend అవ్వాలి, చాలా tension గా ఉంది.
steps.model_visible_text: Oh, sorry. నా pincode 560001. నేను online classes attend అవ్వాలి, చాలా tension గా ఉంది.

steps.purpose: Verify customer identity using the provided pincode.
Check network status in the customer's area.
Return network status indicating no outage.
Agent confirms verification, states no outage, and initiates diagnostic.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent grounds their response on the tool result stating no outage and moves to the mandatory line diagnostic.
steps.text: Thank you, account verify అయ్యింది. మీ area 560001 లో ఎలాంటి outage లేదు. Line diagnostic run చేస్తాను, line లో ఉండండి.
steps.planner_rationale: With identity verified and no outage found, the agent proceeds to the mandatory line diagnostic.

steps.purpose: User agrees to wait for the diagnostic.
Run remote diagnostic on the subscriber's line.
Return diagnostic results showing good signal but unsupported handset.
Agent explains the diagnostic result, attributing the issue to the handset.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent explicitly states the signal strength and handset support status from the diagnostic tool, without blaming the network.
steps.text: Diagnostic complete అయ్యింది. మీ signal strength -85 dBm ఉంది, కానీ మీ handset మా network కి support చేయట్లేదు. Network లో ఎలాంటి problem లేదు.
steps.planner_rationale: The diagnostic reveals the handset is unsupported, which the agent must communicate cleanly.

steps.purpose: User restates figures and hesitates, seeking reassurance.
steps.clean_text: Signal -85 dBm ఉందా? అంటే నా phone problem ఆ? నేను కొత్త phone కొనాలా? ఇది confirm గా phone problem ఏనా?
steps.model_visible_text: Signal -85 dBm ఉందా? అంటే నా phone problem ఆ? నేను కొత్త phone కొనాలా? ఇది confirm గా phone problem ఏనా?

steps.purpose: Agent reassures the customer based purely on facts.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent reassures the customer based on facts without promising network improvements or making unauthorized guarantees.
steps.text: అవునండి, network signal clear గా ఉంది. మీ present handset support చేయట్లేదు కాబట్టి, compatible device కి మారితే ఈ problem solve అవుతుంది.
steps.planner_rationale: The customer needs reassurance; the agent confirms the issue is the handset as per the diagnostic result.

ir.terminal_condition: Customer informed that their handset is unsupported based on the diagnostic, resolving the complaint without a network ticket.
